snippet.title: R3 - The Art of Rocketry Review for the Commodore Amiga by John Gage
snippet.description: R3 - The Art of Rocketry is a Shoot 'em up, Collect 'em up game that came out in 1995 by Bruce Webster. This was a game request by Amiga Bang. Warning! This video has swearing.
